THE THESIS / 001

CODING AGENTS HAVE A TERMINAL.
TAPRIG GIVES THEM HANDS.

Phone automation usually stops at coordinates and screenshots. TapRig treats every device as a durable actor with live state, scoped credentials, typed actions, bounded recovery, and evidence-backed completion.

The model decides only where judgment is useful. Known setup, unlock, execution, waits, retries, and verification remain deterministic—faster, cheaper, and inspectable.
